text:
maya: Quick heads-up — changelog cutoff for v0.9.1 is 4:00pm PT today. If you have user-facing changes, drop a one-line entry + PR link in the changelog folder and add the label `changelog:yes` to the PR. We turned on stricter linting for this cut so please follow the template. thx :pray:

jonathan: ack. i'm going to add the auth-prefetch tweak — will paste a short line. ping me if wording needs change. :+1:

li: question — do we still want category prefixes like "Added/Fixed/Changed"? or just freeform bullets?

maya: yes keep the Conventional-like prefix (Added/Fixed/Changed/Docs). helps the release notes generator. keep it to ~1 sentence, mention component (eg: runtime, console), and include PR URL.

sasha: re: linting — what's the rule set? will it fail CI or just warn?

arjun: lint is enforced on merge for release branches. locally you can run the same checker:```bash
./scripts/changelog-lint.sh path/to/unreleased/*.md
# or via node
npm run changelog:lint -- path/to/file.md
```

changelog-lint-bot: FYI I will comment on PRs missing the prefix/component/PR link after 3pm PT. Use `changelog:skip` label if it's intentionally internal.

jonathan: adding my entry now: "Fixed: reduce auth prefetch contention (runtime) — #3087". putting under unreleased/0.9.1.md

li: small follow-up — does the version bump happen in this PR or a follow-up? cc @sasha

sasha: for this release we want version bumps in a dedicated commit on the release branch. keep changelog entries separate. we'll automate the bump at cut if everything's green.

maya: note for branch coordination: if you need a backport to stable, mark the PR with `backport-needed` label and add the target branch. we'll triage backports after the cutoff.

arjun: also added a tiny helper script in tools/ to assemble the unreleased notes into release_notes.md — it normalizes prefixes and trims to 80 chars. run `tools/assemble_changelog.sh 0.9.1`

jonathan: thanks — ran the linter locally, fixed a grammar hiccup, pushed.

changelog-lint-bot: Checked PR #3087 — lint passed ✅

deploy-bot: Reminder: branch protection will block merges to release/v0.9.x after 4:15pm PT. Plan final merges now if needed.

maya: perfect. if anyone wants a last sanity check on their wording, drop it here and i'll skim. otherwise i'll batch-apply small copy edits after cut. :mag_right:

li: posting mine here for quick proofread — "Added: runtime telemetry flag to reduce KV cache thrash (runtime) — #3092"

maya: looks good, maybe change 'thrash' -> 'evictions' for clarity.

li: updated. thanks.

sasha: merging remaining non-blocking fixes now. will watch for lint comments.

maya: awesome — will close this thread after cut. thanks everyone! :tada:
